traceability.notes:
The story docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md describes establishing the foundational ESLint plugin structure, including rule registry, flat-config integration, metadata, TypeScript implementation, error handling, and documentation.
All acceptance criteria and listed requirements are implemented and verified: - Core plugin structure, exports, and metadata are implemented in src/index.ts and validated by tests/plugin-setup.test.ts and tests/plugin-default-export-and-configs.test.ts. - The plugin uses a dynamic rule registry and exposes recommended/strict flat-config presets with defined severities, fulfilling REQ-RULE-REGISTRY, REQ-CONFIG-SYSTEM, and REQ-ESLINT-COMPAT; this is further validated by tests/config/flat-config-presets-integration.test.ts. - Error handling around rule loading and CLI behavior is explicitly implemented with try/catch and fallback rules, and is tested in tests/plugin-setup-error.test.ts and tests/cli-error-handling.test.ts, satisfying REQ-ERROR-HANDLING. - The project is a TypeScript-based ESLint plugin package with a proper package.json, build/test scripts, and docs for plugin and rule development and ESLint 9 setup, meeting REQ-TYPESCRIPT, REQ-NPM-PACKAGE, REQ-TEST-SETUP, and the documentation-related acceptance criteria. - All referenced tests pass in the current test run.
Based on this concrete evidence, the story 001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP is fully implemented and remains in a passing state.
